scenes.vo: Seven hundred thousand copies. VisiCalc sold the Apple II.
Before 1979, changing one number meant recalculating every cell by hand.
Bricklin watched his professor erase and rewrite cells. He imagined a magic blackboard.
Paper maze in, instant math out. Months of hard coding changed business forever.
VisiCalc. The killer app for business computing everywhere.

caption:
Dan Bricklin invented the spreadsheet in 1979

He watched his Harvard professor erase a blackboard model. VisiCalc let one change recalculate everything instantly.

Send this to whoever lives in Excel.
